results.title: The Christmas Showdown
results.overview: Former best friends April and Chastity compete for the same event design job at a Christmas show. They must overcome their past falling-out and work together to impress the producer, but rivalry intensifies.

results.title: They, With an Axe
results.overview: The inhabitants of a town are interviewed following the commotion that took place last night at the festival: an axe, a woman in a dress, and hairy legs, like those of a man.

results.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
results.overview: In the turbulent shadow of the 1998 regime collapse, a young activist's defiance against state tyranny leads to his brutal abduction, triggering a painful struggle for survival in captivity and a desperate search for answers by his family.

results.title: Tales from the Black Forest
results.overview: Video essay on Heart of Stone, folktales and gothic horror by film and literature scholar Mary Going. Included on the Eureka! Entertainment release of of the 1950 DEFA film "Heart of Stone," or "Das Kalte Herz", the original German title.

results.title: Nesma
results.overview: Shortly after her caregiver, Olfat, passes away, 12 year-old Nesma is forced to live life as Olfat; manipulating everyone into thinking that Olfat is still alive to avoid going back to the orphanage.

results.title: Malpaís
results.overview: Government conspiracy abounds when a mountain appears from thin air in 1940s New Mexico.

results.title: Skin
results.overview: A fashion student is put under harsh stress when trying to craft her final college assignment, but during the process discovers a horrific new addiction

results.title: The Lord of All Future Space & Time
results.original_title: The Lord of All Future Space & Time
results.overview: With the help of a duffle bag from the future, a grief-stricken cowboy avenges the death of his wife.

results.title: With You in the Future
results.overview: Carlos and Elena are about to sign a divorce when they receive an unexpected gift that will allow them to travel back in time. Back in the '90s, that nostalgic era of leather jackets, rowdy hairstyles and pop-rock, they will seek to change their destiny.

results.title: Dream Animals the Movie
results.original_title: たべっ子どうぶつ THE MOVIE
results.overview: The exciting adventures of Lion, Rabbit, Cat, and other animal friends. They embark on a journey filled with laughter and wonder to save their world or find something precious. Along the way, they meet mysterious new characters and face various challenges that test the strength of their friendship.

results.title: Menagerie
results.overview: The death of Dadi leaves the fate of the farm to one of three dysfunctional siblings. Set in the South Wales Valleys, this Welsh-language dark comedy explores familial tensions as war erupts within.

results.title: Shhhhh
results.overview: A social media influencer struggles to cope with the idea that her toxicity could have caused a follower to have committed suicide.

results.title: Srishti
results.overview: Lured to the forbidden forests of the Himalayas, a photojournalist unearths secrets that unravel his mind and challenge the very nature of reality.

results.title: When Mom Is Away... With the In-laws
results.overview: After the phenomenal success of the first two films, “When Mom is Away” and “When Mom is Away… With the Family,” the adventures of the Rovelli family continue! This time, they’re heading to Puglia, where their eldest daughter, Camilla, is moving to attend university with her boyfriend, Antonio.

results.title: Lucas and Arthur Jussen play Bartók @ Frankfurt Radio Symphony Orchestra
results.original_title: Lucas et Arthur Jussen jouent Bartók Orchestre symphonique de la Radio de Francfort
results.overview: In The Chairman Dances, John Adams makes Mao dance and Nixon play the piano. In a completely different vein, Harmonielehre pits percussion against melody and strings and winds against rhythm.  In Bartók's concerto for two pianos, timpani and xylophone provide a third solo part.  David Robertson conducts the Frankfurt Radio Symphony Orchestra.

results.title: Lift Me Up
results.overview: Chị Ngã Em Nâng is a touching story about two siblings, Thương and Lực, who grew up in a family devoted to the traditional craft of incense making. Tragedy struck early, leaving Thương as the sole support for her younger brother — taking on the roles of both sister and parent. Growing up with hardships, Thương relied on her resilience and the deep-rooted teachings of their parents to persevere and change their lives. She eventually found success and hoped her brother would follow the same path. However, her well-meaning imposition unintentionally created cracks in their bond, pushing the siblings into painful conflicts — even to the point of facing life and death.

results.title: Lacuna
results.overview: Reclusive art student Mia’s fledgling romance with Danny, a charming boy from her class, is threatened by the ghosts of her past.
